name: CI (Build universal wheel + Test + Publish)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  release:
    types: [ published ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  # 1) Build sdist + universal wheel (pure Python)
  build_dist:
    name: Build distributions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install build tooling
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build twine

      - name: Build sdist and wheel
        run: python -m build --sdist --wheel --outdir dist

      - name: Check distribution metadata
        run: twine check --strict dist/*

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/*

  # 2) Test from source on all OS/Python
  test_source:
    name: Test (source) py${{ matrix.python-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest ]
        python-version: [ '3.12', '3.13', '3.14', '3.15' ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install package (from source)
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install .
          pip install ".[polars]" || true
          # torch (via sentence-transformers) may lag new Python releases;
          # the embedding tests skip when it is not installed.
          pip install ".[embeddings]" || true

      - name: Install test deps
        run: pip install pytest==9.2.0

      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m pytest -q tests

  # 3) Test the built wheel on all OS/Python
  test_wheel:
    name: Test (wheel) py${{ matrix.python-version }} on ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [ build_dist ]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest ]
        python-version: [ '3.12', '3.13', '3.14', '3.15' ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7.1.0

          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Download built dists
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8.0.2
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist

      - name: Install built wheel
        shell: bash

          python -m pip install --upgrade pip

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
